SettledResponse.note: Settled markdown: paragraph, bold heading line, bullet list with inline code. Prose sits at --text-message inside the thread column.

WithCodeBlock.note: Fenced ts block renders through the DS code-block shell with its language label and copy affordance; inline code keeps the prose size.

WithTableAndQuote.note: Heading, GFM table inside its bordered scroll shell, blockquote and ordered list all render in one message.

StreamingTail.note: isStreaming with animateReveal={false} pins the reveal frontier at the end of the source, so the still frame shows the whole painted prefix instead of a random mid-fade.
